Special Functions

These functions accept real Double64, Double32, and Double16 arguments. Load them with using DoubleFloats.

FamilyCalls
Bessel functions of the first kindbesselj0(x), besselj1(x), besselj(n, x) with integer order n
Bessel functions of the second kindbessely0(x), bessely1(x), bessely(n, x) with integer order n
Gamma functiongamma(x)
Error function and its complementerf(x), erfc(x)
Arithmetic-geometric meanagm(a, b), agm1(x) for agm(one(x), x)
Complete elliptic integral of the first kindellipk(m) with parameter m

For the logarithm of the absolute gamma function and its sign, use DoubleFloats.logabsgamma(x). The Bessel, gamma, and error functions use Float128 internally. See the Accuracy Report for sampled functions and domains.

Arithmetic-geometric mean and elliptic integral

Use same-type positive inputs for the usual arithmetic-geometric mean. The iteration stops when the gap ceases to shrink. ellipk(m) uses the parameter m. If your formula is expressed in terms of the modulus k, pass k^2. The implemented real domain is 0 ≤ m ≤ 1, with an infinite result at m = 1.

using DoubleFloats

k = df64"0.5"
m = k^2
@assert isinf(ellipk(one(Double64)))
string(ellipk(m))
"1.6857503548125960428712036577990686"
